desc: The Weatherby Model 307 MZY is a bolt action muzzleloader built on the Model 307 action, using the Arrowhead Gen2 sealed rifle primer ignition system, a 26" spiral fluted barrel with Accubrake DST muzzle brake, Graphite Black Cerakote metalwork and a carbon fiber stock. Offered in .45 and .50 caliber, with or without Williams peep sights.
